verdict.rationale: Ollama has a hosted cloud tier (cloud models callable via API key) and a first-party pricing page, so the axis applies. The evidence only mentions vague plan features like concurrent models, dedicated capacity, and "more usage"; it never states actual tiers, prices, rate limits, or caps. Missing for 10: named pricing tiers with prices, documented rate limits, explicit usage caps or quotas, independent corroboration of the limits.
